query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM entity_access ea
            WHERE ea.entity_id = $1 AND ea.entity_type = $2 AND ea.source_type = 'user'
              AND ea.granted_from_project_id IS NULL
              AND (ea.source_id = $3
                   OR (ea.source_id LIKE 'macro|%' AND lower(ea.source_id) = $3))
        ) AS "is_user!"
